They stay playable and are shown with Forge's own texts. Rebalanced MTG Arena cards (A-…) are recognized on their own and not listed here. The catalog build fails for an unmatched Forge card that is not listed, and for a listed card that is no longer unmatched: each Forge update decides them deliberately (cards/README.md).
